text:
anya: heads up — found a weird sampling skew in the windowed eval runner that can leak holdout samples when the promptbank embargo boundary aligns with our time-window sharding. reproducer below.

anya: steps: 1) generate synthetic promptbank with embargo cutoff at T; 2) run windowed-runner with window_size=1h and shuffle_across_windows=true; 3) observe holdout hits in generation logs.

anya: minimal repro run: `./tools/eval-runner --mode windowed --window-size 3600 --shuffle-across-windows` then `grep HOLDOUT out.log | wc -l` -> >0 for a seeded fixture.

ci-bot: test report: eval-runner/integration/windowed_sampling: FAILED (2/120 assertions) — see https://ci.redwood/example/214506 for logs :warning:

dmitri: thanks — can you paste a short snippet from the log where it picks samples from adjacent windows?

anya: log excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T14:00:01Z [runner] shard=42 window=2026-03-15T13:00:00Z samples=512
2026-03-15T14:00:02Z [sampler] seed=1337 picked=sample_id=holdout-0007 embargo_ts=2026-03-15T13:30:00Z
2026-03-15T14:00:03Z [runner] sending sample to model: sample_id=holdout-0007 origin_window=2026-03-15T12:00:00Z
```
anya: note origin_window != shard window -> that's the contamination.

kevin: so shuffle_across_windows=true is intended for variance reduction but should still respect embargoes. looks like the sampler's `embargo_check` runs before shuffling, but the later cross-window merge loses the embargo tag.

lia: short-term mitigation: set shuffle_across_windows=false in CI to stop this flake. long-term: ensure sample metadata (origin_window + embargo_ts) is immutable throughout pipeline.

sarah: +1 on immutable metadata. also we should add unit tests: 1) sample with embargo inside window but origin in previous window should be filtered; 2) when shuffle applied, assert embargo_ts is considered.

dmitri: i've drafted a patch: https://gh.redwood/infra/runner/pull/922 — changes: attach `embargo_tag` to Sample proto, prevent samplers/mergers from dropping it, and add `embargoed_sample` fixture for CI.

anya: ran patch locally; integration tests now pass locally: `./tools/test-integration --filter windowed_sampling` -> OK. pushing build.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #922 — 6 jobs queued.

kevin: once merged, we should backfill a short-lived check in the dashboard: add a gauge for "holdout hits per 10k samples" in Redwood Console eval page so we detect regressions quickly.

lia: also add a lint rule in eval-harness: `require_sample_meta_tags` that fails schema validation if embargo_ts missing for time-windowed runs.

anya: opened follow-up ticket: https://trello.redwood/board/ENG-ML-529 "explicit embargo propagation + dashboard alert"

sarah: can we also add an e2e fuzz test that generates random embargo boundaries and window sizes to catch edge cases?

dmitri: yes — i'll add a fuzz job under `eval-runner/fuzz/embargo` and a CI nightly job.

ci-bot: PR #922 merged into main (commit abc1234). CI: all green. :tada:

anya: thanks everyone — will monitor the dashboard once nightly backfill runs. tag me if you see any holdout hits. :eyes:
